inputs.text: The “No Kings” crowd seems to confuse defying authority with defending freedom. Whatever their slogans, activists who turn public streets into a confrontation are putting ordinary people and civic order at risk. Federal officers used tear gas and made arrests, with at least 13 confirmed in Portland and Denver; that should remind everyone that protest does not excuse breaking the rules. A decent society depends on shared standards and respect for the law, not crowds deciding they answer to no one.
